%S Axxxxx-diagonal 0,0,1,3,9,23,60,155,388,1004,2480,6467,15963,41832,103547,272494,677229,1787823,4460878
%N Axxxxx-diagonal Number of free polyplets (A030222) with n cells whose symmetry group has order 2, generated by a reflection in a diagonal axis.
%C Axxxxx-diagonal A polyplet (polyking) is a set of unit cells joined through shared edges or corners. The square symmetry group D4 partitions the free polyplets A030222 into 8 classes by exact symmetry group; this is one of them. The five reflection-containing classes (axial, diagonal, two-axis, two-diagonal, full) sum to A030234 (bilaterally symmetric); the other three (asymmetric, 180-degree, 90-degree) sum to A030235. Polyplet analogue of A006748 (polyominoes). - _Jason H Parker_, Jul 05 2026
%F Axxxxx-diagonal Obtained via the table of marks of the square symmetry group D4 from the counts of fixed polyplets (A006770) invariant under each subgroup. The 8 symmetry classes partition A030222(n), and the five reflection classes sum to A030234(n); both checked for all n <= 19.
%Y Axxxxx-diagonal Cf. A030222 (free polyplets), A030234, A030235, A006770 (fixed polyplets), A006748 (polyomino analogue).
%K Axxxxx-diagonal nonn,more
%O Axxxxx-diagonal 1,4
%A Axxxxx-diagonal _Jason H Parker_, Jul 05 2026
